subject: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Finance trial
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@atlasfinance.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Finance trial

Hi Sarah / team,

Thanks again for the call today — good alignment on goals. As promised, here’s a concise post-call recap and a suggested POC plan so we can lock scope and get a kickoff on the calendar. I attached a one-page POC plan (Redwood_POC_plan_v1.pdf).

High-level POC goals (4-week trial):
- Validate integration stability and latency under expected load
- Measure end-to-end cost per token and per-inference economics
- Verify quality against Atlas Finance prompt set and human-review thresholds

Proposed success criteria / KPIs (please confirm or propose edits):
- Latency: p95 inference latency <= 300 ms for 512-token requests (measured at Redwood edge to Atlas region)
- Throughput: sustained throughput target of 50 requests/sec (mixed seq lengths) with <= 5% error rate
- Cost: average model cost <= $0.0008 per token for served traffic (we’ll provide cost breakdown by token class)
- Quality: automated eval on 50 seed prompts with pass rate >= 90% (exact test harness in attached doc) + human eval median rating >= 4/5 on a 100-sample blind set

Ownership & roles:
- Jordan Blake (AM) — program owner, contractual/ops point of contact
- Dev Patel (SE) — integration, metrics collection, test harness setup
- Marissa Cole (AE) — commercial/contract items, billing coordination

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the success criteria above or share tweaks by end of day Friday (6/19)?
2) Share a sample prompt set and representative payloads (PII redacted) — Sarah, if you can drop that into the Drive link, Dev will start baseline runs
3) Kickoff: propose Wed 23 Jun, 10:00–11:00 PT for a 60-min technical kickoff + data handoff

Attachments: Redwood_POC_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sarah Lee <sarah@atlasfinance.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@atlasfinance.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Finance trial

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. This looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes / small edits to propose: 

- Latency: could we capture both client-to-edge p95 and model p95 separately? For compliance we need the model-side numbers as well.
- Throughput: 50 req/sec sounds right for peak. Can we add a smoke test at 100 req/sec for 2 minutes to validate headroom?
- Cost: target is reasonable; would like a per-call breakdown in the reporting dashboard.
- Quality: agree to the automated + human eval approach. Our QA team will provide the 100-sample blind set by EOD Monday (6/22).

We can provide an initial sample set (PII removed) today — I’ll upload to the Drive link you shared. On kickoff timing — Wed 23 Jun 10:00 PT works for Michael and me.

On compliance: we need at least 90-day logs retention and the ability to export audit logs at the end of the trial. Can you confirm Redwood’s retention/export options?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Product, Atlas Finance
sarah@atlasfinance.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@atlasfinance.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Finance trial (technical plan)

Hi all,

Following on Jordan’s plan — I put together a short technical evaluation plan and the tests I’ll run once we have sample payloads. Main points: 

1) Baseline runs (Day 0–1)
- Run 500 single-request samples and capture model-only p95, median, and stddev for 128/512/1024 token lengths
- Capture cold-start behavior and initial KV cache hit rates

2) Throughput ramp (Day 2–4)
- Gradually ramp to 50 req/sec sustained for an hour, capture error rates and tail latency
- Headroom smoke test: 100 req/sec for 2 minutes (monitoring + automatic throttling logs)

3) Cost analysis (Day 1–7)
- Track token counts, batching gains, and per-call inference cost. I’ll produce a CSV with per-call cost breakdown and an aggregated cost-per-token metric

4) Quality testing (Day 3–10)
- Run automated eval harness on the 50-seed prompts (unit tests). Collect pass/fail and accuracy metrics.
- Coordinate with Atlas QA for the 100-sample human blind review; we’ll provide the annotation UI and exportable results.

5) Observability / artifacts
- I’ll share a read-only dashboard link with latency/cost/throughput time series, and a downloadable CSV for each run
- Will provide audit/export of request logs for 90 days as requested (see attached security_questionnaire_answers.docx for compliance notes)

Attachments: security_questionnaire_answers.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

I’ll start baseline runs as soon as you drop the sample prompts & representative payloads into the Drive link.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
From: Sarah Lee <sarah@atlasfinance.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@atlasfinance.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPIs — Atlas Finance trial

Thanks — uploaded sample prompts + payloads to the Drive link (folder: Atlas_POC_samples). A couple clarifications from our side: 

- For quality: our acceptance gating will be automated pass rate >= 90% AND human blind median >= 4.0/5. If either metric fails we’ll review together and iterate.
- Logs: confirmed we need exportable request logs and redaction options; 90 days retention is fine for the trial but we may request extended retention if we move to Dedicated.
- Data volume: initial sample set is small (~500 calls). We’ll scale traffic to simulate production patterns during week 2.

One ask: can Redwood provide per-token and per-call cost estimates for both the initial baseline traffic and a projected 1M-call monthly profile? That will help our finance team.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — see you all Wed 23 Jun 10:00 PT for kickoff.

Best,
Sarah
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@atlasfinance.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:43:00 -0700

Perfect — thanks Sarah. Confirming next steps and owners: 

- Sarah/Atlas: upload final sample set (done) and confirm any redaction rules for logs (owner: Sarah)
- Dev: start baseline runs on Mon 22 Jun and post dashboard + CSVs (owner: Dev)
- Jordan: schedule kickoff Wed 23 Jun 10:00 PT and share calendar invite + agenda (owner: Jordan)
- Marissa: will prepare a short commercial checklist and estimate for 1M-call profile (owner: Marissa)

We’ll also provide the per-call / per-token cost projection ahead of kickoff — Marissa will take the lead on that and loop in finance if needed.

If anything else comes up, reply-all — otherwise I’ll send the calendar invite in the next 30 minutes.

Thanks everyone — excited to get started.

Best,
Jordan
